enabled.label: Enable MusicBrainz
enabled.description: Master on/off for MusicBrainz enrichment. Optional; default off. No API key needed — MusicBrainz is an open service.

user_agent.label: User-Agent
user_agent.description: Identifies Phlix to MusicBrainz (their policy REQUIRES a descriptive User-Agent with contact info). ENFORCED: enrichment only runs when the value contains a URL (the '://' substring) — an email-only UA fails the gate; the plugin silently declines to enqueue or enrich. Include a project/contact URL. Optional — the default is fine; customize if you run a fork.

rate_limit_delay.label: Rate-limit delay (ms)
rate_limit_delay.description: Minimum delay between MusicBrainz requests. Optional; default 1100 (MusicBrainz asks for no more than ~1 request/second). Values below 1000 are raised to the 1000 ms ToS floor; non-integer or ≤0 values fall back to the 1100 default.

auto_enrich.label: Auto-enrich
auto_enrich.description: Automatically enrich music items as they are scanned. Optional; default on.

fetch_album_art.label: Fetch album art
fetch_album_art.description: Pull cover art via the Cover Art Archive. Optional; default on.

search_depth.label: Search depth
search_depth.description: How hard to search for matches: fast, normal or deep. Optional; default normal.
